unique_requirements_transferred: Repository roles must determine applicable exit gates; missing runtime evidence must not block non-runtime repositories solely because they are non-runtime.
Role assignment, workflow success, unit tests, public surface existence, and validation binding must never be treated as operational completion or release authority.
Stale inventory and prior runtime receipts must be labeled historical rather than current.
Every unresolved branch must have a repository-native owner, durable evidence location, and machine-observable release condition.
Progress reporting must distinguish installed implementation from observed operation, evidence, integration, and activation.
collision_boundaries: Do not duplicate issue #117 validator and Site-orchestrator integration work.
Do not duplicate issue #118 successor packet, repository comparison, registry, or archive-queue work.
Do not convert LLM-adapter or Triage blocked evidence into completion.
Do not claim a repaired Site runtime PASS without a newer workflow-produced receipt.
Do not use Site publication as proof authority for destination activation.
